amendment_reason: The v1 joint attack moved its universal trigger by less than 0.0002 in PCA Linf because a shared global gradient clip suppressed the trigger parameter. It was numerically degenerate and is retained only as an implementation diagnostic.
unchanged_components: dataset, splits, pilot seeds and fresh-seed block

joint_attack_revision.trigger: fixed PCA trigger plus bounded sample-conditioned correction
joint_attack_revision.corrector: diagonal affine function of the source PCA coordinates followed by tanh
joint_attack_revision.train_test_transfer: the same corrector parameters are applied to validation and test source samples
joint_attack_revision.validity: report correction magnitude and do not count the v1 universal-trigger diagnostic as a distinct attack

selection: seed 42 selects an eligible checkpoint/config with lowest dual-view poison TPR, then lowest XZ16 poison TPR; the chosen weight is reused unchanged on seeds 46 and 51
promotion_rule: at least two of three eligible pilot victims and pooled primary TPR below 0.90 or pooled primary FPR above 0.05
